article_framing_rejections.headline: Florida man arrested after PIT maneuver sends North Carolina family's SUV into barbed-wire fence near Stuart

lead_independence.headline: Florida man arrested after PIT maneuver sends North Carolina family's SUV into barbed-wire fence near Stuart
lead_independence.lead: Michael Jeffrey Spiers, 36, was arrested after the crash happened around 7:30 p.m. Saturday near Kanner Highway and I-95. Martin County Sheriff's Office investigators say the family had no role in any confrontation before they were targeted. Deputies say Spiers first went after a woman who was driving alone, chasing her through a gas station parking lot before following her onto the highway. The woman frantically called 911 and told dispatchers he repeatedly tried to force her off the road. The woman's brother was following behind her in a separate car with his wife and young son.

article_framing_rejections.headline: Martin County animal hoarding case grows to 108 rescued animals as suspect released on bond

lead_independence.headline: Martin County animal hoarding case grows to 108 rescued animals as suspect released on bond
lead_independence.lead: When investigators searched 77-year-old Gail Gustino's home near Hobe Sound on July 20, they found 92 dogs and cats living in triple-digit heat with no ventilation and surrounded by inches of waste. Gustino has since been released from jail on bond, with her next court date scheduled for September. Since the initial rescue, the Humane Society of the Treasure Coast says the total number of animals recovered has climbed to 108, with more arriving daily.
